summary: Media activities specialist with more than two decades of experience in higher-education marketing, public relations and media production. Manages major campus events, coordinating security, media, food service and marketing, and oversees press conference coverage and newspaper, radio and television interviews. Writes and produces promotional, recruitment and instructional videos, radio and TV commercials, and print and web content. Has supervised creative staff, managed advertising budgets up to $500,000, and developed market research-driven strategic plans with academic leaders. Earlier background includes continuing education program development and hosting a local cable television program on campus and community events.
